description_en: Queries the security report of an Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 获取阿里云账号（主账号）下的用户凭证报告
name: GetAccountSecurityPracticeReport

AccountSecurityPracticeInfo.description_en: The information about the security report for the Alibaba Cloud account
AccountSecurityPracticeInfo.description_zh: 阿里云账号安全报告信息

AccountSecurityPracticeUserInfo.description_en: The information about the security report for the Alibaba Cloud account
AccountSecurityPracticeUserInfo.description_zh: 阿里云账号安全报告信息

BindMfa.description_en:
Indicates whether multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled. Valid values:

true

false
BindMfa.description_zh:
是否已开启多因素认证。取值：

true：已开启。
false：未开启

OldAkNum.description_en: The number of old AccessKey pairs for the Alibaba Cloud account
OldAkNum.description_zh: 阿里云账号中旧访问密钥的个数

RootWithAccessKey.description_en: The number of AccessKey pairs for the Alibaba Cloud account
RootWithAccessKey.description_zh: 阿里云账号访问密钥（AccessKey）的个数

SubUser.description_en: The number of RAM users within the Alibaba Cloud account
SubUser.description_zh: 阿里云账号中RAM用户的个数

SubUserBindMfa.description_en: The number of RAM users that have MFA devices bound
SubUserBindMfa.description_zh: 绑定了多因素认证设备的RAM用户的个数

SubUserPwdLevel.description_en:
The complexity level of the password for the RAM user. Valid values:

low

mid

high
SubUserPwdLevel.description_zh:
RAM用户密码强度的等级。取值：

low
mid
high

SubUserWithOldAccessKey.description_en: The number of RAM users that use the old AccessKey pairs
SubUserWithOldAccessKey.description_zh: 使用旧访问密钥的RAM用户的个数

SubUserWithUnusedAccessKey.description_en: The number of Resource Access Management (RAM) users that have unused AccessKey pairs
SubUserWithUnusedAccessKey.description_zh: 拥有未使用访问密钥的RAM用户的个数

UnusedAkNum.description_en: The number of AccessKey pairs that are not used for the Alibaba Cloud account
UnusedAkNum.description_zh: 阿里云账号中未使用的访问密钥的个数

Score.description_en: The security score of the Alibaba Cloud account
Score.description_zh: 阿里云账号安全最终得分
